description: This script automates the generation and postprocessing of markdown documentation files from header and JSON files within a project, including running external scripts and cleaning up cache.

methods.name: generate_md
methods.description: Generates markdown files from header files or JSON files in plugin directories.

methods.name: convert_json_to_md
methods.description: Converts JSON plugin files into markdown documentation.

methods.name: convert_h_to_md
methods.description: Converts header files into markdown documentation.

methods.name: postprocess_md
methods.description: Postprocesses markdown files to clean up links and formatting.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point to run the documentation generation and postprocessing workflow.
